spec_case: issue #778 step 7, H1 (uppercase HTTP_PROXY is never read for an http URL)
description: `HTTP_PROXY` (uppercase) points at a closed port; `no_proxy` is cleared so nothing else could mask a bug. The target names the mock server directly -- if the uppercase variable were ever read, the request would be routed to the closed port and fail outright instead of reaching the mock.
